name: callie-founder-sales-system
description: Callie Founder Sales System: the npm workspace root for the API, the worker, the Mac app and their shared packages.

scripts.lint: npm run lint:greenfield && npm run lint:root-scripts
scripts.test: npm run test:greenfield && npm run test:release
scripts.typecheck:greenfield: npm run typecheck --workspace packages/contracts && npm run typecheck --workspace packages/domain && npm run typecheck --workspace apps/api && npm run typecheck --workspace apps/worker && npm run typecheck --workspace apps/desktop && tsc --noEmit -p test/release/tsconfig.json
scripts.lint:root-scripts: eslint --no-ignore --max-warnings 0 -- eslint.config.mjs eslint.greenfield.mjs scripts/verifySecrets.mjs scripts/productionSmoke.mjs scripts/releaseMutationCheck.mjs scripts/releaseMutationRunner.mjs 'scripts/mutations/*.mjs'
scripts.test:greenfield: npm run test --workspace packages/contracts && npm run test --workspace packages/domain && npm run test --workspace apps/api && npm run test --workspace apps/worker && npm run test --workspace apps/desktop
scripts.gate:greenfield: npm run typecheck:greenfield && npm run lint:greenfield && npm run test:greenfield && npm run test:release
